probe_source:
import json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
metadata=json.loads(Path('docs/performance/run-01/metadata.json').read_text())
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OMP_','GOMP_','KMP_','OMPI_','PMI_','PMIX_'))}
env.update(metadata['tuning_env'],OMP_DISPLAY_AFFINITY='TRUE',LC_ALL='C')
command=['build/m4-release/heat_openmp','--threads','1','--N','384','--M','9216','--T','.01','--summary-only']
p=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
states=[]
while p.poll() is None:
 try:
  text=Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/status').read_text()
  mask=next(x.split(':',1)[1].strip() for x in text.splitlines() if x.startswith('Cpus_allowed_list:'))
  threads=len(list(Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/task').iterdir()))
  if not states or (mask,threads)!=(states[-1]['cpus_allowed_list'],states[-1]['tasks']):
   states.append(dict(cpus_allowed_list=mask,tasks=threads))
 except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):
  pass
 time.sleep(.01)
out,err=p.communicate()
assert p.returncode==0 and 'Q_requested=1 Q_actual=1' in err and states[-1]['cpus_allowed_list']=='0' and states[-1]['tasks']==1
record=dict(purpose='binding verification only; excluded from performance samples',revision=metadata['revision'],command=command,tuning_env=metadata['tuning_env'],observed_states=states,returncode=p.returncode,stderr=err,stdout=out,probe_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
Path('docs/performance/run-01/binding-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Q=1 final process affinity CPU 0, one task; excluded probe archived')
